functions.name: sortRecords
functions.notes: libc++ insertion-sort-incomplete for contiguous 8-byte records with an 8-exchange cutoff; reuses the recovered 159 four-record network.

validation.comparison: Zero/one-element ranges, every permutation of sizes 0-6, all 24 permutations of six key sets, targeted cutoff/NaN cases and 60 random 7-20 record ranges compare return, complete memory and stack pointer.
limitations: Invalid reversed/out-of-bounds iterator ranges are not exercised.
Ledger: 240 server bodies recovered and 494 remain machine code.
Ledger: 238 server bodies recovered and 496 remain machine code.
